test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’.

In the afternoon we walk in the Parks; / and I wondered who shod all the horses there, / and wished Joe did.

options.text: In the afternoon we walk in the Parks;
and I wondered who shod all the horses there,

solution:
The correct answer is: **In the afternoon we walk in the Parks;**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence has mixed tenses, which is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the verbs in the first and third parts are in the past tense (wondered, wished).
 
• The verb in the second part, "walk," should also be in the past tense to maintain consistency.
 
• Therefore, the correct form should be 'walked' instead of 'walk'.

Correct sentence: *In the afternoon we walked in the Parks; and I wondered who shod all the horses there, and wished Joe did.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Verb tense consistency means maintaining the same tense throughout the sentence.
 
• Mixing present and past tenses inappropriately can confuse the reader.
 
• Examples:
 
 
• Incorrect: *She **walks** into the room and **sat** down.*
 
• Correct: *She **walked** into the room and **sat** down.*
